snippet.title: Khaadim Se Behtar! Tasbeeh-e-Fatima Sone Se Pehle | Sahih Bukhari 3113 #shorts
snippet.description:
Thakan door karne ka ek nuskha... jo ek khaadim se bhi behtar hai! Jaante hain woh kya hai?

Hazrat Ali Alaihis Salam bayan karte hain: Sayyida Fatima Alaihas Salam chakki peeste peeste thak jaati thein. Woh ek khaadim maangne gayin, to raat ko Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) un ke ghar tashreef laaye, aur farmaya:
"Kya main tumhein woh cheez na bataoon, jo khaadim se behtar hai? Jab tum sone lago, to 34 baar Allahu Akbar, 33 baar Alhamdulillah, aur 33 baar SubhanAllah padho."
«فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَاهُ»
"Yeh tumhare liye khaadim se behtar hai."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 3113: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:3113

Aaj raat sone se pehle, yeh Tasbeeh-e-Fatima zaroor padhein. Comment mein likhein: main padhunga! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
